## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
1 + 1
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
#| echo: false
2 * 2
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).

#1. evaluate which samples need to run for final elisa
```{r}
elisa_mergeMeta <- readRDS("./outs/elisa_mergeMeta_with_offsetVisitDates.rds")
meta <- read_xlsx("./data/20260612_HBV_metadata.xlsx")
dim(elisa_mergeMeta)
elisa_optional <- elisa_mergeMeta[make.unique %like% "optional"]
print(elisa_optional)
elisa_sub <- elisa_mergeMeta[!make.unique %like% "optional"]
table(elisa_sub$Participant)
table(elisa_sub$Visit)
#elisa_sub  <- elisa_sub[!make.unique == "hbvx-0019_v2w4"]

glimpse(elisa_sub)
table(elisa_sub$Study.arm)

expected_visits <- rbind(
  data.table(Study.arm = "HBVimmune-Alum", ExpectedVisit = c("v1w0", "v1w1", "v1w4")),
  data.table(Study.arm = "HBVnaive-Alum",  ExpectedVisit = c("v1w0", "v1w1", "v2w0", "v2w1", "v2w4", "v3w1", "v3w4")),
  data.table(Study.arm = "HBVnaive-CpG",   ExpectedVisit = c("v1w0", "v1w1", "v2w0", "v2w4"))
)
participants <- unique(elisa_sub[, .(Participant, Study.arm)])
master_grid <- merge(participants, expected_visits, by = "Study.arm", allow.cartesian = TRUE)
missing_timepoints <- master_grid[!elisa_sub, on = .(Participant, ExpectedVisit = Visit)]
missing_timepoints[, .(Missing_Visits = paste(ExpectedVisit, collapse = ", ")), 
                   by = .(Participant, Study.arm)]

missing_long_dt <- missing_timepoints[, .(
  make.unique = paste0(Participant, "_", ExpectedVisit),
  Participant,
  Study.arm,
  Visit = ExpectedVisit,
  Status = "Missing"
)]

print(missing_long_dt)

fwrite(missing_long_dt, "./outs/20260612_missing_timepoints_for_final_elisa.csv")

elisa_sub$Participant

#lv location
lv <- read_xls("./data/AdhocExcelExport_CHENH31_Jun-12-2026-12-53-01.xls")
setDT(lv)
glimpse(lv)
lv[, Visit := tolower(`Eventdef Label`)]
lv[, Participant := tolower(gsub("^NLV-", "", `Study Linked ID`))]
lv[, make.unique := paste0(Participant, "_", Visit)]
#concat serum locations
lv[, ShortLoc := gsub(".*/HBVx Serum (\\d+)/([A-Z]\\d+)", "S_\\1_\\2", `Storage Location`)]
glimpse(lv)

# location for missing_long_dt
torun_location <- merge(missing_long_dt, lv[, .(make.unique, ShortLoc)], by = "make.unique", all.x = FALSE)
torun_location <- merge(
  missing_long_dt, 
  lv[, .(ShortLoc = paste(sort(unique(ShortLoc)), collapse = ", ")), by = make.unique], 
  by = "make.unique", 
  all.x = FALSE
)
fwrite(torun_location, "./outs/20260612_missing_timepoints_for_final_elisa_with_location.csv")
```

#2. integrate new data 
```{r}
toadd <- fread("./data/20260616_final hbv elisa.csv")
elisa_mergeMeta <- readRDS("./outs/elisa_mergeMeta_with_offsetVisitDates.rds")

str(elisa_mergeMeta)
#glimpse(elisa_mergeMeta)
glimpse(toadd)
toadd[, Participant := substr(sample, 1, 9)]
setnames(toadd, "sample", "make.unique")
toadd[, Visit := sub("^.{9}_", "", make.unique)]

exclude_cols <- c("make.unique", "Visit", "Participant", "elisa.HBsAb")
cols_to_check <- setdiff(names(elisa_mergeMeta), exclude_cols)

is_list_col   <- sapply(elisa_mergeMeta[, ..cols_to_check], is.list)
atomic_cols   <- cols_to_check[!is_list_col]
list_cols     <- cols_to_check[is_list_col]


## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
## 3. Helper: get the single consistent value for an atomic vector
##    (returns NA if it varies, or if it's all missing)
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
get_consistent_value <- function(x) {
  ux <- unique(x[!is.na(x) & x != ""])
  if (length(ux) == 1) return(ux)
  return(NA)
}

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
## 4. Helper: get the single consistent value for a list-column entry
##    (returns list(NULL) if it varies, or if it's all missing)
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
get_consistent_value <- function(x) {
  ux <- unique(x[!is.na(x) & x != ""])
  if (length(ux) == 1) return(ux)
  return(x[NA_integer_])  # NA of the same type/class as x
}

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
## 5. Build per-participant lookup tables
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
participant_meta_atomic <- elisa_mergeMeta[
  , lapply(.SD, get_consistent_value),
  by = Participant, .SDcols = atomic_cols
]

participant_meta_list <- elisa_mergeMeta[
  , lapply(.SD, get_consistent_list),
  by = Participant, .SDcols = list_cols
]

participant_meta <- merge(participant_meta_atomic, participant_meta_list, by = "Participant")

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
## 6. (Optional) Inspect which columns actually vary within a participant
##    -- review this before trusting full automatic transfer
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# varies_within_participant <- sapply(atomic_cols, function(col) {
#   any(is.na(participant_meta_atomic[[col]]) &
#         elisa_mergeMeta[, any(!is.na(get(col)) & get(col) != ""), by = Participant]$V1)
# })
# print(varies_within_participant)

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
## 7. Merge participant-level metadata into the new rows
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
toadd_full <- merge(toadd, participant_meta, by = "Participant", all.x = TRUE)

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
## 8. (Optional) Backfill NAs in the existing table from sibling rows,
##    only where that column is consistent for that participant
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
impute_consistent_meta <- function(dt, id_col = "Participant", cols) {
  dt <- copy(dt)
  for (col in cols) {
    dt[, (col) := {
      vals <- get(col)
      ux <- unique(vals[!is.na(vals) & vals != ""])
      if (length(ux) == 1) {
        fifelse(is.na(vals) | vals == "", ux, vals)
      } else {
        vals
      }
    }, by = id_col]
  }
  dt
}

elisa_mergeMeta <- impute_consistent_meta(elisa_mergeMeta, cols = atomic_cols)

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
## 9. Combine new rows into the main table (fill = TRUE for any
##    columns toadd_full doesn't have, e.g. truly visit-specific ones)
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
elisa_mergeMeta <- rbindlist(list(elisa_mergeMeta, toadd_full), fill = TRUE)
table(elisa_mergeMeta$Participant, elisa_mergeMeta$Visit)

elisa_mergeMeta[Participant == "hbvx-0085", .(make.unique, BMI, Sex, Race, Product, elisa.HBsAb)]
names(elisa_mergeMeta)
#elisa_mergeMeta[, elisa.HBsAb := fcoalesce(elisa.HBsAb.x, elisa.HBsAb.y)]
#elisa_mergeMeta[, c("elisa.HBsAb.x", "elisa.HBsAb.y") := NULL]
elisa_mergeMeta[Participant == "hbvx-0099", .(make.unique, BMI, Sex, Race, Product, elisa.HBsAb)]
elisa_mergeMeta[make.unique %like% "optional", .(make.unique, BMI, Sex, Race, Product, elisa.HBsAb)]

list_col_check <- sapply(elisa_export, is.list)
names(list_col_check)[list_col_check]
list_cols <- c("PastHistory", "ImmunizationHx", "MedsAtEnrollment")

elisa_export <- copy(elisa_mergeMeta)

for (col in list_cols) {
  elisa_export[, (col) := sapply(get(col), function(x) {
    if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) return(NA_character_)
    paste(x, collapse = "; ")
  })]
}

# confirm conversion worked BEFORE writing
sapply(elisa_export, is.list)
glimpse(elisa_export)
#elisa_export <- copy(elisa_mergeMeta)
fwrite(elisa_export, "./outs/20260616_final_elisa_merged_metadata.csv")



```
